h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rohtak

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Rohtak

c: Rohtak has a strong sporting culture, especially in wrestling and athletics, and plenty of young people who train outdoors. It is also an education centre with a university and a large medical institute. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to Rohtak for schools, colleges, sports grounds, parks and residential societies. We manufacture it at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,120 km away. Our in-house design team can also adjust colours from our 15+ roto-moulded shades to match a campus or society theme.

Buyers here often want two kinds of users served on one site: athletes who want real strength work and older residents who want light exercise. That means mixing body weight stations with gentle, seated machines. We plan the layout so the two groups do not get in each other's way. Delivery is by road, and installation is by our team or a dealer in north India.

items.q: Can an outdoor gym serve both athletes and senior citizens?
items.a: Yes. Put body weight stations at one end and seated, low-impact machines at the other. We mark both zones on the layout drawing so committees can see how the space will be shared.
The ABB Trainer is meant for abdominal work. The Parallel Bar also works the core during dips and leg raises. Both are body weight machines with nothing to adjust.

items.q: Does winter fog or summer dust damage the machines?
items.a: Galvanised frames and moulded parts handle both conditions. Wiping the moving parts regularly keeps dust out of the bearings, which are covered by a 1-year warranty.
